name: Methodology for Improved Agricultural Land Management
description: Quantifies GHG benefits from improved cropland, grazing and agroforestry management: soil organic carbon change plus CH4, N2O and fossil-fuel emissions, via measurement and/or modelling.
formula: NER_t = (ΔSOC_PROJ,t − ΔSOC_BSL,t) × 44/12 + (E_BSL,t − E_PROJ,t) − GHG_LK,t  (E = CH4, N2O and fossil CO2e emissions)

parameters.name: Net GHG emission reductions/removals
parameters.description: Net benefit credited in monitoring period t

parameters.name: Change in soil organic carbon stock
parameters.description: Project vs baseline SOC change over the period

parameters.name: Baseline non-CO2 and fossil emissions
parameters.description: CH4, N2O, fossil fuel emissions in baseline

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Improved agricultural land management practices on cropland, grassland or agroforestry
Baseline practices documented; SOC quantified by measurement, model or both
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0042 v2.2 (Verra ICVCM announcements)

name: Biochar Utilization in Soil and Non-Soil Applications
description: Credits carbon durably stored in biochar (soil or non-soil use) after deducting production, transport and leakage emissions.
formula: NER_y = Q_biochar,y × C_org × PF × 44/12 + BE_feedstock,y − PE_y − GHG_LK,y

parameters.name: Persistence fraction
parameters.description: Share of carbon remaining after the crediting horizon

parameters.name: Avoided baseline feedstock emissions
parameters.description: Emissions the feedstock would have caused otherwise

applicability: Biochar produced from eligible biomass and applied to soil or durable non-soil products
Carbon content and persistence tested per methodology
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0044 v1.2 (Verra ICVCM announcement Aug 2025)

name: Sustainable Grassland Management (SGM)
description: Credits emission reductions and removals from improved grassland management, including changes in soil carbon and livestock-related emissions.

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Managed grasslands with a documented change in grazing/land management
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0026 (summary; version not pinned)

name: Methodology for the Adoption of Sustainable Grasslands through Adjustment of Fire and Grazing
description: Credits carbon gains and avoided emissions from adjusting fire and grazing regimes on grasslands.

parameters.name: Leakage emissions
parameters.description: Emissions displaced outside the project boundary as a result of the activity

applicability: Grasslands where fire and grazing management are changed by the project
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0032 (title from VCS methodology list, partially confirmed; version not pinned)

name: Soil Carbon Quantification Methodology
description: Methodology for measuring and quantifying soil organic carbon stock changes for soil-carbon projects.
formula: SOC (tC/ha) = BD × d × C_org(%);  ΔSOC = SOC_t2 − SOC_t1;  tCO2e = ΔSOC × 44/12

parameters.name: Soil bulk density
parameters.description: Measured bulk density of the layer

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Soil carbon quantification with repeat field sampling
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0021 (title/code from memory of VCS list; not re-verified; version not pinned)

name: Quantifying N2O Emissions Reductions in Agricultural Crops through Nitrogen Fertilizer Rate Reduction
description: Credits N2O emission reductions from lowering nitrogen fertiliser application rates on cropland.
formula: ER_y = (N_BSL,y − N_PROJ,y) × EF × 44/28 × GWP_N2O − GHG_LK,y  (N applied in kg N; EF in kg N2O-N per kg N)

parameters.name: Global warming potential of nitrous oxide
parameters.description: Value prescribed by the programme for the crediting period

applicability: Crop systems where fertiliser N rate is reduced without a yield-compensating shift outside the project
sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0022 v1.1 (Verra Scope 3 RFP page)

name: Methodology for Rewetting Drained Temperate Peatlands
description: Credits avoided peat oxidation and CH4 changes from rewetting drained temperate peatlands.
formula: ER_t = (E_BSL,t − E_PROJ,t) − GHG_LK,t;  E = Σ (A × EF_CO2) + Σ (A × EF_CH4 × GWP_CH4)

parameters.name: CO2 emission factor
parameters.description: By water-table class or site type

parameters.name: CH4 emission factor
parameters.description: By water-table class or site type

parameters.name: Global warming potential of methane
parameters.description: Value prescribed by the programme for the crediting period

sourceRef: Verra VCS VM0036 (title/code from memory; not re-verified; version not pinned)

name: Soil Organic Carbon Framework Methodology
description: Framework methodology for quantifying SOC sequestration and related emissions from land-management practice changes.

parameters.name: Project emissions
parameters.description: Emissions caused by the practice change

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Land-management practice changes affecting soil organic carbon
sourceRef: Gold Standard Soil Organic Carbon Framework Methodology (not re-verified; version not pinned)

name: Soil Enrichment Protocol
description: Protocol quantifying GHG benefits from soil-enriching agricultural practices via biogeochemical modelling with field measurement.
formula: ER = (ΔSOC_PROJ − ΔSOC_BSL) × 44/12 + (ΔN2O_BSL − ΔN2O_PROJ) + (ΔCH4_BSL − ΔCH4_PROJ) − PE − LK

parameters.name: CO2-to-C molecular weight ratio
parameters.description: Converts carbon stock changes (tC) to CO2 equivalents

applicability: Cropland and rangeland practice changes that enrich soil carbon
sourceRef: Climate Action Reserve Soil Enrichment Protocol (not re-verified; version not pinned)

name: Cropland: mineral soil carbon stock change (stock-change method)
description: IPCC stock-change approach for mineral soil carbon using reference stocks and relative stock-change factors for land use, management and input.
formula: SOC = Σ (SOC_REF × F_LU × F_MG × F_I × A);  ΔC_mineral = (SOC_0 − SOC_(0−T)) / D
applicability: Mineral soils on cropland (Tier 1 defaults available)
Guidance methodology, not a crediting programme
sourceRef: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol.4 Ch.5 (uses Ch.2 Eq. 2.25)

name: Grassland: soil carbon stock change
description: IPCC approach for carbon stock change on grassland, with management and input factors applied to soil reference stocks.
formula: SOC = Σ (SOC_REF × F_LU × F_MG × F_I × A);  ΔC_mineral = (SOC_0 − SOC_(0−T)) / D
applicability: Guidance methodology, not a crediting programme

name: N2O emissions from managed soils
description: IPCC method for direct N2O emissions from nitrogen inputs to managed soils.
formula: N2O_direct-N = (F_SN + F_ON + F_CR + F_SOM) × EF1 (+ other terms);  N2O = N2O-N × 44/28

parameters.name: N from soil organic matter loss

applicability: Guidance methodology, not a crediting programme
